scope: Additive TH18 Lava Hound/Lava Pup death-split baseline; parent death explosion remains disabled.
game_version: Official February 2026 TH18 evidence and secondary parent/child pages consulted on 2026-09-20.

sources.title: The February Update has escaped!
sources.limitations: Confirms Lava Hound L8 at TH18, but not child values, counts, split or explosion lifecycle.

sources.title: December Update - Patch Notes
sources.limitations: Records the 3.5-tile parent explosion radius, but not a complete current damage, target, timing, collision or ordering contract.

sources.title: Lava Hound/Lava Pup
sources.limitations: Reports a fixed L1 Pup table (50 HP, 35 damage, 32 speed, 1-second cadence, 2-tile range, air/ground) and parent offensive counts L1-L8 of 8/9/10/11/12/13/14/15. No immutable build, split timing/coordinates, projectile/collision or target-order trace is published.

sources.title: Lava Hound
sources.limitations: Consulted only as a cross-check. Its Lava Pup presentation conflicts with the selected secondary table on range/priority and supplies no version, count progression, split trace or deterministic lifecycle; it is not used for imported values.

support.note: Core spawns documented Lava Pups through the deterministic queue on attacker death; parent explosion remains disabled.

known_uncertainties: No version-identified current child table or verified asset exists.
The consulted cross-check conflicts with the selected secondary table on Lava Pup range/priority, so it is recorded but contributes no imported value.
Split timing, circular radius/orientation, coordinates, launch, projectile/collision and target ordering are unknown; Core queues Pups at parent position in stable order.
Parent explosion remains disabled because its current target, damage, timing, collision and ordering contract is incomplete.
conclusion: Lava Hound L1-L8 and required Lava Pup L1 share Core, Headless, Viewer and RL paths for a source-backed death-split baseline. Parent explosion, split geometry/timing, projectile collision and asset fidelity remain partial.
